How badges work

Badges are earned automatically from every Trackman session (radar misreads removed); each player page shows the date the badge was earned (for 80% badges: the date the 80% mark was reached and has held since). Gold = headline badges. Cards show the top 4.

  • Bronze & Gold (every distance & hang badge below): 🥉 Bronze = did it at least once (one FG make / kick / punt). 🥇 Gold = consistency: the mark is hit on 80% of attempts/kicks in the last 90 days. FG: 80%+ made of FG attempts from that distance, min. 5 attempts · kickoffs: 80%+ of all kickoffs, min. 10 · punts: 80%+ of all punts, min. 10 (pooch punts not counted). Gold replaces Bronze of the same badge.
  • 🏆 50-Yard Club: 80% of FG attempts from 50+ yd made (min. 5) · 60+ Club: 80% of FG attempts from 60+ yd made (min. 5)
  • ⏱ Kickoff Hang 4.0+: 80% of kickoffs hang 4.0+ s (min. 10) · 🚀 Kickoff 70+: 80% of kickoffs 70+ yd (min. 10) · Punt Hang 4.8+ / elite Punt Hang 5.0+: 80% of punts (min. 10) · 🦵 Punt 50+: 80% of punts 50+ yd (min. 10)
  • 💯 90% FG: career field goal accuracy of 90%+ with a minimum of 20 FG attempts (all sessions, radar misreads removed)
  • 📊 Career averages (all sessions, radar misreads removed, min. 10 qualifying kicks each): FG Avg Make 45+ / gold FG Avg Make 50+: average distance of made FGs over 45 / 50 yd (min. 10 makes) · Kickoff Avg 60+ / gold Kickoff Avg 65+: kickoff distance average over 60 / 65 yd (min. 10 kickoffs) · Kickoff Hang Avg 3.8+: kickoff hang average 3.8+ s (min. 10 kickoffs) · Punt Avg 40+: punt distance average over 40 yd · Punt Hang Avg 4.0+: punt hang average over 4.0 s (min. 10 punts; pooch punts not counted)
  • 🎯 40+ yd FG: 80% of FG attempts from 40+ yd made (min. 5) · ✅ 80%+ FG in a session with 10+ attempts
  • 🚀 60+ yd KO: 80% of kickoffs 60+ yd (min. 10) · 🦵 40+ / 45+ yd punt: 80% of punts 40 / 45+ yd (min. 10) · 📅 10 / 25 / 50 / 100 sessions
  • ★ New PB!: the latest session set a personal best (longest FG make, kickoff or punt distance/hang), shown for 45 days
